senses.gloss: f. ch. = h.כִּיפָּהvault, vaulted chamber; arcade.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:13:3">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵈ</cite> top <he>תפשיתון כיפ׳</he> the vaulted chamber (in the bath) seized them (kept them spell-bound).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:1:9">Y. Naz. VII, 56ᵃ</cite> top <he>כ׳ דקסרין</he> the arcade of the gate of Caesarea (considered unclean); Y. Ber. III, 6ᵃ <he>כִּפְתָה דק׳</he>.—Pl. <cite ref="K00572"><he>כִּיפִּין</he></cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 5, v. <cite ref="K01044"><he>כְּפַף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 41:12">Targ. Job XLI, 12</cite> <he>דעביד כיפא</he> which forms a bow (in boiling over; h. text <he>ואגמן</he>); cmp. <cite ref="K00603"><he>כִּיפָּה</he></cite> beg.
